syntax.passing_assertion: Every planned .js unit reaches indexed, parse_error or excluded with exact spans.
syntax.failure_rule: Any unit vanishes or syntax error becomes empty success.

imports.passing_assertion: ES imports and aliases match expected facts.
imports.failure_rule: Name-only guess or removed import retained fails.

exports.passing_assertion: Alias and direct re-exports match exactly.
exports.failure_rule: Re-export omission or all declarations exported fails.

names.passing_assertion: Three same functions retain distinct scope ids.

calls.passing_assertion: Alias call resolves; untyped receivers remain ambiguous; missing/external stay distinct.
calls.failure_rule: Dynamic receiver promoted to resolved or missing call omitted fails.

types.passing_assertion: No compiler-grade type support is advertised.
types.failure_rule: Syntax or JSDoc guess promoted to resolved types fails.

frameworks.failure_rule: Generic JavaScript success promoted to framework support fails.

incremental.passing_assertion: Mutation forces stale/full rebuild and never claims incremental.
incremental.failure_rule: Silent stale reuse or incremental advertisement fails.
